claim.claim-text: 1. A solar cell, comprising:

3. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 2, wherein the substrate further comprises at least one cut edge side surface (C2) adjacent to and between the first surface and the second surface; only the first surface and the portion of the first side surface comprise the textured structure, and the doped conducting layer is only disposed on the first surface and the portion of the first side surface to cover the textured structure.

4. The solar cell according to claim 3, wherein in the normal direction of the cut edge side surface, the cut edge side surface is flush with edges of the doped conducting layer, the first passivation layer, the passivating contact layer, and the second passivation layer located on the same side as the cut edge side surface; or wherein the first passivation layer furtherr at least partially covers the cut edge side surface.
5. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 2, wherein the substrate further comprises at least one cut edge side surface adjacent to and between the first surface and the second surface;

at least a portion of the cut edge side surface comprises the textured structure, and the doped conducting layer is disposed on the first surface, the portion of the first side surface, and the portion of the cut edge side surface, thereby covering the textured structure; and the first passivation layer further covers at least the portion of the cut edge side surface, thereby covering at least the doped conducting layer.

6. The solar cell according to any one of claims 3 to 5, wherein the second passivation layer further at least partially covers the cut edge side surface, thereby covering at least a portion of the first passivation layer located on the cut edge side surface.

7. The solar cell according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the second passivation layer further at least partially covers the first side surface, thereby covering at least a portion of the first passivation layer on the first side surface.
8. The solar cell according to claim 7, wherein the first side surface comprises a textured region provided with the textured structure and a flat region adjacent to the textured region;
9. A method for manufacturing a solar cell, comprising:

forming a passivating contact layer on the second surface of the substrate, forming a first passivation layer on the doped conducting layer, wherein the first passivation layer covers the first surface and at least the portion of the first side surface, thereby covering at least the doped conducting layer, and forming a second passivation layer on the passivating contact layer, thereby forming a solar cell matrix (103), wherein the second passivation layer covers the second surface, thereby covering the passivating contact layer.

10. The method according to claim 9, wherein after forming the second passivation layer on the passivating contact layer, the method further comprises: laser cutting the solar cell matrix along the thickness direction (H) to form at least two solar cells.
11. The method according to claim 9, wherein the providing the wafer comprises:

performing texturing treatment and diffusion of dopant elements to at least the first surface and the first side surface of the substrate; and etching the substrate to expose the second surface and a first target region (C11) of each first side surface of the substrate, wherein the first target region is adjacent to and connected to the second surface.
12. The method according to claim 9 or 10, wherein the providing the wafer comprises:
13. The method according to any one of claims 9 to 12, wherein the forming the passivating contact layer on the second surface of the substrate comprises:
14. A photovoltaic module, comprising at least one cell group (210), wherein the cell group comprises at least two solar cells according to any one of claims 1 to 8.
15. A photovoltaic system, comprising the photovoltaic module (200) according to claim 14.
